summary: The local-observation trim no longer holds the store's writer for seconds, and no longer runs right after a daemon start

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes; the trim deletes exactly the rows it deleted before.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or triggers change; the schema and its digest are unchanged.

rules.detail: Retention, the per-subject-and-kind cap and every protected row (the newest of each subject and kind, start evidence, pending usage readings, launcher bindings) are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Local observations never replicate; members on older builds are unaffected.

downtime.detail: The first trim pass runs 10 to 15 minutes after a daemon start instead of at once. On a 57 GB member with 26,002 rows past retention the old pass held the writer for 20 s right after the restart and emptied the write-ack budget for the hour; on a store of that shape the longest writer hold of a pass is now 2 to 10 ms.

manual.detail: No configuration changes. Each pass now logs one line: rows deleted, free pages given back, longest writer hold and pass time; it replaces the separate 'trimmed N local observations' and 'gave N free pages back' lines.
